```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
annotation_table = read_tsv(here("data/signatures/202506_TB_signatures_info.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# cols to drop if the input already has them
id_cols <- c("signature_ID", "number", "dataset_ID", "dataset_signature_ID")
is_aggregated <- function(x) grepl("aggregated_signature$", x)

# previously assigned IDs (if present) -- used only to check the result is stable
previous_ids <- if ("dataset_signature_ID" %in% names(annotation_table)) {
  setNames(annotation_table$dataset_signature_ID, annotation_table$signature_name)
} else NULL

individual_signatures <- annotation_table %>%
  select(-any_of(id_cols)) %>%
  filter(!is_aggregated(signature_name))

# sort individual signatures
sorted_annotation_table <- individual_signatures %>%
  arrange(
    desc(technology),
    tissue_category,
    sample_origin,
    tissue_cell_type,
    series_id,
    factor(tb_status, levels = c("PTB", "EPTB", "LNTB", "MTB")), # KEEP AS IS requires order for ID assignment
    desc(disease_samples),
    desc(control_samples),
    signature_name
  )

# append aggregated LAST (figure S6 relies on this)
aggregated_signatures <- annotation_table %>%
  select(-any_of(id_cols)) %>%
  filter(is_aggregated(signature_name))

if (nrow(aggregated_signatures) == 0) {
  aggregated_signatures <- tibble::tibble(
    signature_name  = c("microarray_aggregated_signature", "RNAseq_aggregated_signature"),
    signature       = c(1, 1),
    up_genes_num    = c(98, 98),
    dn_genes_num    = c(98, 98),
    technology      = c("microarray", "RNAseq")
  )
}

aggregated_signatures <- aggregated_signatures %>%
  arrange(factor(technology, levels = c("microarray", "RNAseq")))

sorted_annotation_table <- bind_rows(sorted_annotation_table, aggregated_signatures)

# assign IDs: s<row>, d<dataset> (aggregated rows share one dataset ID since series_id is NA)
sorted_annotation_table <- sorted_annotation_table %>%
  mutate(
    signature_ID = paste0("s", row_number()),
    number = row_number(),
    dataset_ID = paste0("d", match(series_id, unique(series_id))),
    dataset_signature_ID = paste(signature_ID, dataset_ID, sep = "_")
  )

# sanity checks before writing -- downstream figures depend on these
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(sorted_annotation_table$signature_name),
  sum(is_aggregated(sorted_annotation_table$signature_name)) == 2,
  all(is_aggregated(tail(sorted_annotation_table$signature_name, 2)))
)

# individual signature names embed their ID
indiv <- sorted_annotation_table %>% filter(!is_aggregated(signature_name))
name_mismatch <- indiv %>%
  filter(!endsWith(signature_name, paste0("_", dataset_signature_ID)))
if (nrow(name_mismatch) > 0) {
  print(select(name_mismatch, signature_name, dataset_signature_ID))
  warning("dataset_signature_ID no longer matches the suffix in signature_name for the rows above")
}

# Warn if any signature got a different ID than in the input
if (!is.null(previous_ids)) {
  changed <- sorted_annotation_table %>%
    mutate(previous = previous_ids[signature_name]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(previous), previous != dataset_signature_ID)
  if (nrow(changed) > 0) {
    print(select(changed, signature_name, previous, dataset_signature_ID))
    warning("signature IDs changed compared to the input file -- downstream figure labels will change")
  }
}

# keep the original output columns only (drop metadata columns added to the input later)
sorted_annotation_table <- sorted_annotation_table %>%
  select(-any_of(c("signature_full_name", "experimental_platform", "time_point", "source", "cell_name")))

write_tsv(sorted_annotation_table, file = here("figures/figure2_tableS3_S4/metadata_annotation/annotation_table.tsv"))

```
